title: Explicit normalized global-cochain comparison
statement: Let (C,J) be a site and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Let A,B be integer-indexed complexes of R-module sheaves [def-pur-hom-complex]. The explicit normalizedHomGlobalCochains equivalence sends a map s from the rank-one free module sheaf to Hom(A,B)^n to the ordinary cochain whose (p,q) component, p+n=q, is the morphism associated to s followed by the product projection exposed by homComplex_projections_exists. Its inverse is the unique product lift of the inverse internal-Hom section equivalences. This additive equivalence commutes with the ordinary cochain differential in all pairs of degrees. No cocycle or quotient restriction is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 0A8Z (equation-global-cohomology-hom-complex), using the product and differential of Section 0A8X

proof.text: Use the product projections of the chosen homComplex_exists record. On each factor, unitHomEquiv and homObjSectionsEquiv identify maps from the rank-one free sheaf with morphisms of module sheaves. The product universal property gives the explicit inverse and both inverse identities.

Apply the Hom differential projection formula to each component. Composition of internal-Hom sections becomes composition of morphisms, so the formula is the ordinary cochain differential. Nonconsecutive degrees give zero by the complex shape.
